author: KEXP
description:
Born out of a desire to fuse the urgency of post-punk, the freedom of jazz, and the raw energy of Haitian roots music, Paris-based outfit ZONBI channel passion into a their powerful sonic world. 

Our trip to Trans Musicales brought tons of new music discovery to music lovers everywhere. It's what we love to do! If you've enjoyed learning abut new artists and sounds through these special remote sessions, make a donation to our Spring Drive and help sustain this home for music curation and discovery.
title: ZONBI performs "Lanmou Ak Lanmo" and more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

author: KEXP
